prior_seal.scope: Prior seal and actual prior producer/input bytes; not execution evidence for current changed producer

limitations: Caller serialized portable state; native unspecified bytes not assigned host layout
No actual device, SPI, GPIO, syscall or network operations in native oracle; host SPI/GPIO captured before singleton
Native Core bodies never executed; actual pinned CCL provider observations imported
Native D0 calls original unsized delete; host compiler may use actual sized delete, both instrumented and forwarded to real runtime. No binary runtime equivalence
Host C1/C2 proof uses concrete derived construction; every exact name checked and every native original range independently executed
Destructor source-port noexcept/host allocation runtime is not original ARM exception compatibility
Serial precondition requires explicit serial binding; original unencoded return declaration remains pending
